paper_location: Main Section 4.4 and Figure 5(e), AV-HuBERT baseline
selection: All available SA, SI, and SX utterances from all 59 volunteers; frontal and 30-degree views.
preprocessing: 25 fps timestamp resampling, 68 facial landmarks, smoothed stable-point alignment, 96 by 96 grayscale lip crops, complete clips retained.
data_fields: Counts and public corpus identifiers; transcripts, audio, and source video are not included.
